title: House in the woods
content: I just stumbled upon this sub. In my dreams, the places I usually go don’t tend to resemble a mall, but I have gone to hotels instead. Anyways, the most recurring one is not really an hotel, but a house in a small forest village. It resembles an old south-German house, with wood of redish tones. I can’t really recall the things I do or see in high detail, but I always come to this place in dreams. When I’ve been inside, it’s kind of dark, woody and labyrinth- like. I once reached the rooftop and it was way way bigger than it seemed to be, something that had no logic because it was too big, and from the rooftop the whole thing looked like a gothic church of sorts. I’m going to begin journaling because I didn’t know there was people experiencing the same thing. I have never been this intrigued by something in so many years.
